description: Recent container logs of an installed One-Click App on a dedicated server (secrets and login links removed). Read them before suggesting a restart. Requires an active ZapX Pass (see server instructions).

serviceId.description: ID of the Dedicated server: the "id" field from list_account_services or list_dedicated_servers (e.g. "cmabc123..."). The numericId shown in the panel (e.g. "180") is accepted too. IDs of other service types do not work here.

name: get_dedicated_app_logs
title: Get Dedicated Server App Logs
